description.narrative: The overall objective of this action is to strengthen the EU-Caribbean partnership for cooperation in the field of circular economy in general and of SWM in particular and improve the resource efficiency of Caribbean economies. The specific objective of this action is to better align SWM systems in Caribbean countries with circular economy principles and National Determined Contributions and make them more able to attract investments.

title.narrative: 1. Regional exchanges on challenges and solutions to prevent the entry of plastic waste into the Caribbean Sea are established.

description.narrative: 1.1 Analysis and evaluation of the documentation for the events (event programs, video recordings, social media) towards their content and regional orientation.Evaluation of the participant profiles incl. gender, geographical breakdown and professional groups (public institutions, private industry, universities, civil society)1.2 Quantitative evaluation of the processes (e.g. evaluation of the regional monitoring of waste flows, digital knowledge platform, political dialogue) towards their content and regional orientation.Analysis of the MAP with regard to participation from the SICA and CARICOM partner countries and Mexico.

title.narrative: 2. The capacities of the private sector for the management of plastic waste in the Dominican Republic are strengthened.

description.narrative: 2.1 Analysis and evaluation of the documentation (e.g. protocols, flyers, videos) of the companies regarding the concrete application of the instruments (e.g. material flow management, marine litter tool)2.2 Analysis and evaluation of the documentation of the business models with regard to their feasibility and content, focusing on plastic waste
Ten companies have used innovative and/or digital instruments to reduce their plastic waste in the Dominican Republic.

comment.narrative: Less Plastic Guide Sustentur 42 hotels in 9 countries are applying the guide to reduce unnecessary plastics in the tourism and hotel sector. In the DO 7 hotels around Bayahibe area applied the digital tool and are developing concrete action plans. The guide and supporting documents are publicly available on the CCAD website see link in the annex.

description.narrative: 3.1 Analysis and evaluation of the concepts with regard to their focus on plastic waste3.2 Analysis and evaluation of the minutes of meetings of the partnerships regarding the adoption of their action plan. Implementing partners monitoring reports

In each of three pilot areas, local stakeholders from public institutions, the private sector and/or civil society have agreed on a concept with actions to prevent the discharge of plastic waste into the Caribbean Sea.

comment.narrative: For each of the pilot projects Municipality of Miches SamanProvince Puerto Plata Province a concept with actions to prevent plastic waste at the entrance to the Caribbean Sea was coordinated developed and adopted. There are agreements and letters of understanding signed by the interested parties.In the first year of implementation Caribe Circular signed MoUswith the following partner municipalities Municipality of Miches 31.03.2022 in collaboration with the EUfunded GIZ project El Seibo Resiliente 6 Municipalities in the Saman Province July 29th in Santa Barbara in collaboration with the GIZ project daBIO. Municipalities of the North Coast June 30th.Additional progress made Signing of a framework MoU between the Ministry MIMARENA and Caribe Circular to collaborate in the pilot projects 2022. Preparation of a detailed action plan and proposal for a public resolution Singleuse plastic free Municipality in Miches. All pilot municipalities signed a letter of commitment related to the use and maintenance of the recollection tricyclemotors which will support the implementation of the recycling models in all areas.

title.narrative: Solid waste management systems in Caribbean countries are better aligned with circular economy principles and National Determined Contributions and more able to attract investments.

description.narrative: Solid waste management systems in Caribbean countries are better aligned with circular economy principles and National Determined Contributions and more able to attract investments.
Number of innovative approaches/initiatives used to support waste treatment and diversion in the region.

comment.narrative: Two approaches initiatives are already in use at least pilot phaseMobile Awareness and Recycling Station A Circular mobile station was installed to promote environmental education plastic waste prevention and recycling. The station was launched September 6th 2023 during a public event with the participation of the EU ambassador in the DR. First educational activities have been realized already by the municipality in collaboration with a local publicprivate alliance see output 3.Awareness Raising and Recycling in Sports Events In collaboration with the Dominican Baseball League LIDOM and the private recycling NGO NUVI the action designed and implemented an initiative to sensitize baseball fans at the national level to prevent and recycle plastics. The pilot phase was successfully implemented during the season 20222023 with 1 ton of plastic waste collected and recycled. The regular implementation phase will take place during the season 20232024 see output 4.
